# UX & IME Focus Checklist: Cycle Movement Goal Search Keyboard & Filtering

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality, clarity, and completeness for on-screen keyboard focus and movement search filtering in the New/Edit Cycle modal
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are the window-hierarchy and input-method focusability requirements for the `"Search movement…"` input field explicitly defined so that non-IME popup window flags cannot block the soft keyboard? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Is the filtering behavior specified with exact matching semantics (case-insensitive, trimmed substring match, blank query returns all movements)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are the requirements for clearing the search query (`"Clear search"` action) and displaying an empty-state message (`"No matching movements found"`) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]

## Interaction & State Consistency

- [x] CHK004 Is the state transition when selecting a movement from the filtered list (updating selected movement, triggering metric/baseline auto-fill, clearing search query, hiding keyboard, and collapsing panel) consistently specified across `spec.md` and `contracts/ui-movement-goal-selector-contract.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the toggle-collapse behavior when tapping the `Movement (Basic)` trigger row while already expanded (`Change ▴`) defined to preserve the existing selected movement and reset any partial search query? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Cases & Measurability

- [x] CHK006 Are multi-goal-card independence and bounded list scrolling alongside the active on-screen keyboard addressed in the edge cases and UI contract? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK007 Are the measurable outcomes in `Success Criteria` verifiable through deterministic unit/UI tests without breaking backward compatibility of `GoalDraftState` and `CycleGoal`? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-003]

## Notes

- All `CHK001..CHK007` requirement-quality items verified against `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/ui-movement-goal-selector-contract.md`.
